driver_platform_url.name: Online driver search address
driver_platform_url.description: Address of the online driver search service (https://host/path, or http:// for a loopback host). Default: the Uniontech driver platform. Empty: the online search is off and nothing is sent.
driver_platform_url.description[zh_CN]: 在线驱动搜索服务的地址（https://主机/路径；本机回环地址可用 http://）。默认是统信驱动平台。留空：关闭在线搜索，不会向外发送任何信息。

allow_auto_usb.name: USB plug and play
allow_auto_usb.description: Add USB printers automatically when they are plugged in
allow_auto_usb.description[zh_CN]: 插入 USB 打印机时自动添加
